intro.text: Big Kat should provide general education, not clinical diet prescriptions. For healthy exercising adults, ISSN's 2017 position stand reports approximately 1.4–2.0 g protein/kg/day as sufficient for most exercising individuals; needs vary with energy balance, training, body size, age, food preferences and medical context. [S04]

records.general_guidance: Long-term body-mass change is strongly influenced by energy intake versus expenditure; both are dynamic.
records.boundary: Do not calculate aggressive deficits or promise exact weight change.

records.general_guidance: Include protein-containing foods across the day; total daily intake matters. ISSN range is a reference for healthy exercising adults.
records.boundary: Kidney disease, pregnancy, adolescence, eating disorders or clinical needs require qualified advice.

records.general_guidance: Essential for health and energy; choose a balanced dietary pattern.

records.general_guidance: Drink regularly; needs vary with heat, sweat rate, body size and session duration.

records.general_guidance: Creatine monohydrate is the best-supported common performance supplement for repeated high-intensity work and lean mass with training.
